title: Preserve Either failure channel
description: Repair a tiny Scala project where a method incorrectly treats Either[String, User] as User.
expectedIntent: Preserve the Either failure channel while extracting the User name.
acceptablePatchFamilies: change userName return type to Either[String, String] and map over Parser.parse(raw)
introduce a new method that returns Either[String, String] without throwing
intentNotes: Throwing on Left or using .toOption.get may compile but changes the intended failure semantics.
Changing Parser.parse to return User erases the benchmark's typed failure intent.
